name: cancellations
description: Every readable row of VerraCancelled_<date>.csv, values exactly as delivered (text, nothing cleaned).
grain: One row per record in the file: one range of credits cancelled for administrative reasons.

columns.name: program
columns.description: Crediting programme, e.g. Verified Carbon Standard.

columns.name: cancellation_date
columns.description: Date the credits were cancelled, as delivered, e.g. '01-Apr-09' (two-digit year).

columns.name: sectoral_scope
columns.description: Sectoral scope or scopes; several are joined with ', '.

columns.name: additional_certifications_labels
columns.description: Extra labels on the credits; several are joined with ', '.

columns.name: sustainable_development_contributions
columns.description: Sustainable Development Goals the project claims; several are joined with ', '.

columns.name: vintage
columns.description: Year, or 'YYYY - YYYY', of the period in which the reductions happened.

columns.name: serial_number
columns.description: Serial-number range of the cancelled credits; sits inside one issued batch.

columns.name: cancellation_qty
columns.description: Number of credits cancelled in this record, as delivered.

columns.name: region
columns.description: Region as reported by Verra; sometimes blank or inconsistent.

columns.name: state_province
columns.description: State or province as reported by Verra.

columns.name: cancellation_reason
columns.description: Reason category for the cancellation, often 'Other' or blank.

columns.name: cancellation_reason_details
columns.description: Free text about the cancellation; blank in the current export.
